title: New catalog bound bandwidth_demand 1..4096 has no rejection test (the bw > 4096 branch is never exercised)
detail: The S3 load-time wrap guard (the u32 demand-total bound) is new validation with NONE coverage of its rejection branch; the repo's own convention pins every catalog bound (cf. the 'lane 256 wraps' rows).
recommended_fix: Add a pkt_rows reject row: replace1(PKT_VALID, "bandwidth_demand": 1, "bandwidth_demand": 4097) expecting 'bandwidth_demand must be 1..4096'.

title: Warnings port re-key (S4/F3) never tested with bidirectional load — the max-vs-pooled-sum divergence is unpinned
evidence:
worst := max(press[int(bs) * PORT_DIR_COUNT + int(PORT_DIR_LO_TO_HI)],
		             press[int(bs) * PORT_DIR_COUNT + int(PORT_DIR_HI_TO_LO)]) — both covering fixtures are unidirectional: warnings_test.odin:169-171 `for k in u64(1)..=6 { sla_spawn(&s, 1, 0, res, host)` (test_pipe_congestion_lane_bound) and warnings_test.odin:376-377 `for k in u64(1)..=6 { sla_spawn(&s, 1, 0, res, host) // 6 packets, one lane, at the E9 bound` (test_pipe_congestion_multi_member_bundle).
detail: All res→host spawns ride dir 0 only; reverting worst to the pooled sum (press_lo + press_hi) passes the suite unchanged. The AV-7/F3 max-never-sum convention is untested at its only divergent point.
recommended_fix: Add a test splitting the 6-packet load across both directions (e.g. 5 forward + 5 reverse): assert NO Pipe_Critical (pooled sum would read 10/6 → red).

title: Residency ledger layout reset on Topology.gen (same-count renumber) has no regression test
detail: The review-swarm fix for the same-count renumber leak (120 phantom ticks, PR body) ships with no pin; deleting the layout_gen check fails no test. The tx-ring analog HAS test_bundle_tx_ring_rebuild_reset.
recommended_fix: Mirror the tx-ring reset test: record residency, redraw/demolish to renumber bundles at same count, assert port_residency_ticks reads 0 and slot_tick zeroed.

title: Stats pipe-row AV-4 form (util MAX over directions, tx_octets Σ) measured only with the reverse direction unserved — a sum-util implementation passes
detail: The fixture is bidirectional but at the single read point w_hi=0, so util_pct = u_lo+u_hi and tx_octets = forward-only both pass. The ratified AV-4 max-never-Σ convention is mutation-indistinguishable at its only test.
recommended_fix: Step the congested fixture past the reverse port's first serves (or assert at two ticks): pin util = max (never Σ → ≤100) and tx_octets = Σ of both windows.

title: port_util_pct pinned only pre-traffic (0) — the AV-4 'saturated reads 100, never 200' denominator pin is absent
detail: The comment names the AV-4 pin but the assertion only covers the zero path; util_pct_window's clamp is tested in units_test but not through the per-direction read.
recommended_fix: After the full-duplex drain fixture (both directions ~100% for a window), assert port_util_pct == 100 for each direction — never a pair-summed 200.

title: port_residency_ticks staleness-fold read path (idle key reads 0 after window expiry) untested
detail: The hunter-fold fix ('residency staleness folds at READ time — idle keys read 0', PR body) has no regression pin; a frozen-win regression would fail no test.
recommended_fix: Mirror the tx-ring expiry test: accumulate residency, advance > RESIDENCY_WINDOW_TICKS idle ticks, assert the key reads 0 (stale slots excluded at read).

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (S1-S5 mutation legs + re-pins all verified present and biting); P1 ≈85% (AV-4 util form, F3 warnings directional, catalog bound branch unpinned at divergence); overall ≈82%. Reads-contract conventions carry the shortfall.
recommended_fix: Add the four warning-level tests (catalog 4097 row, bidirectional warnings split, residency layout-reset mirror, stats Σ/MAX at two read points) to lift P1 ≥90% → PASS.
